principle: One lexical record can belong to many packs; never force one word into one category.

rules.communication: NGSL/common-general membership plus daily-life, people, travel, food, home and high-frequency function words.
rules.workplace: BSL membership plus office, business, finance and workplace domains.
rules.toeic: TSL membership combined with NGSL; this is vocabulary support, not official exam content or score conversion.
rules.academic: NAWL membership plus education, science, research and formal-writing domains.
rules.picture_candidate: Concrete nouns, animals, food, objects, places, body parts and visible actions; editor confirmation required.
rules.polysemy_candidate: More than one sense or more than one POS; teach senses separately in context.
rules.pronunciation_candidate: Has IPA; a near-homophone relation still requires human pronunciation verification.
